data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 (claim $909) and SRC_012 (claim $855) SHARE the mechanism of the standard overtime premium (1.5× base for hours beyond 40), but the $909 calculation abstracts this into a base-for-all-plus-premium-only form (47×$18 + 7×$9), while $855 uses the standard replacement form (40×$18 + 7×$27). They share the underlying premium mechanism but differ in whether the overtime rate replaces or supplements the base rate. REFUTED IF: the two calculations do not share the 1.5× premium as a common causal component, or if $909 is causally independent of the standard overtime rule.
